auto_upgrade_capacity.description: When set to true, your cluster will be automatically upgraded when best-practice RAM/CPU thresholds are exceeded in a 12-hour rolling window.

high_availability.description: When set to yes, at least 3 nodes are provisioned in 3 different data centers to form a highly available (HA) cluster and your data is automatically replicated between all nodes.

high_performance_disk.description: When set to yes, the provisioned hard disk will be co-located on the same physical server that runs the node.

id.description: Autogenerated ID assigned by the Typesense engine.

memory.description: How much RAM this cluster should have. Available options here: https://typesense.org/docs/cloud-management-api/v1/cluster-management.html#memory

name.description: A string to identify the cluster for your reference in the Typesense Cloud Web console.

region.description: Region where the nodes should be geographically placed. Available options here: https://typesense.org/docs/cloud-management-api/v1/cluster-management.html#regions

search_delivery_network.description: When not off, nodes are provisioned in different regions and the node that's closest to it's originating location serves the traffic.

typesense_server_version.description: Cluster Typesense server version at creation time.

vcpu.description: How many CPU cores this cluster should have. Available options here: https://typesense.org/docs/cloud-management-api/v1/cluster-management.html#vcpu
